void Slice(MatrixH<dims, Type>& slicedMat, std::initializer_list<std::optional<std::pair<size_t, size_t>>> slice) {
        uint index = 0;
        size_t offsets[dims];
        bool firstNonNullStrideFound = false;
        memset(offsets, 0, dims * sizeof(size_t));
        memcpy(slicedMat.shape, shape, dims * sizeof(size_t));
        Type* MemArena;
        
        for (auto i : slice) {
            if (i.has_value()) {
                offsets[index] = i->first;
                
                slicedMat.shape[index] = i->second - i->first;
                
                if (!firstNonNullStrideFound) {
                    MemArena = new Type[slicedMat.accumul(index, dims)];
                    size_t stride = index == 0 ? slicedMat.accumul(index+1, dims) : slicedMat.accumul(0, index);
                    
                    SliceBuffer(MemArena, buffer + offsets[index] * stride, stride, slicedMat.accumul(index+1, dims), slicedMat.shape[index]);
                    firstNonNullStrideFound = true;
                    index++;
                    continue;
                }
                size_t stride = accumul(index, dims);
                size_t size = slicedMat.accumul(index, dims);
                uint noOfOp = slicedMat.accumul(0, index);
                ;[
                SliceBuffer(MemArena, buffer + offsets[index] * stride, stride, size, noOfOp);
            }
            index++;
        }
        slicedMat.total_size= slicedMat.accumul(0, dims);
        memcpy(slicedMat.buffer, MemArena, sizeof(Type) * slicedMat.total_size);
    }
